topic: Day 38 — carousel — Vulnerability isn't oversharing, it's saying the scary specific thing

slides.text: It's saying the one scary, specific thing.
Volume of disclosure isn't the same as depth.
One risky admission does more than a lot of safe ones.

caption:
Dumping every detail isn't intimacy. Saying the one specific thing you're scared will change how someone sees you is.

Follow for one of these a day.
